description: Machine-readable registry of the DB schema migrations shipped with plugin releases. One entry per plugin X.Y version whose release contains schema changes; a plugin X.Y with no entry ships no DB migration. pluginVersion is the machine key: a PR always knows its own plugin version (build.gradle on its target branch), while the core version a release pairs with is only decided at release time - the supertokens-core release workflow does that translation, deriving its has-db-migration flag from whether the plugin X.Y being released has an entry here. coreVersion is informational: the core X.Y whose SaaS upgrade applies this migration, matching the CORE_MIGRATIONS registry in supertokens-backend-apis (helpers/multi-tenancy/rds/migration), which must contain the corresponding entry before the SaaS rollout of that core can run. Pre-7.0-core migrations are out of scope (handled by the SaaS legacy migration path only). Keep entries sorted by pluginVersion ascending.

migrations.notes: Account linking: primary_or_recipe_user_id columns, pagination index rework, password reset token FK + email column.
Drops the user_roles -> roles foreign key so roles no longer need to exist before being assigned.
Bulk import tables + session_info (user_id, app_id) index.
WebAuthn tables (10.1.0), emailverification and user_roles indexes (10.1.2).

Schema rework (supertokens-core PR #1275): recipe_user_account_infos / recipe_user_tenants / primary_user_tenants, activity_log, FK rework to ON UPDATE CASCADE. custom: the pagination indexes must be built with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside any transaction (see comments in the SQL file), and the release requires the user-record backfill arm of the SaaS upgrade orchestrator.
Refresh token rotation columns on session_info.
